errors.lockedOut: {minutes, plural, one {Too many failed attempts. Try again in # minute.} other {Too many failed attempts. Try again in # minutes.}}
errors.inactive: This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Phase 0 foundations are in place. Fleet, customer and contract data arrive in Phase 1.
dashboard.notYetBody1: These tiles deliberately show only what exists. The KPIs from SOW §3 — fleet counts, monthly revenue, cost, profit, customer outstanding, supplier payables, expiring documents — are milestone 1E, and each will be an aggregation over the ledger rather than a stored column.
dashboard.notYetBody2: Showing placeholder numbers now would make the system look further along than it is.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Everyone who rents or leases a vehicle. Identity documents are attached to each customer and watched for expiry.

detail.readOnly: You do not have permission to edit this customer.
detail.statusHint: A blacklisted customer stays on file and keeps their history, but should not be given a new contract.
detail.dangerHint: The customer is hidden from lists and search. Contracts, payments and history are kept.

errors.mobile: Enter a UAE mobile number, for example 050 123 4567.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.subtitle: Companies DrivenX leases vehicles from. Their bank details are used for supplier payments.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Company, code, contact, TRN or phone

form.trnHint: 15 digits, from the supplier’s VAT certificate.
form.ibanHint: Checked before it is saved — a mistyped IBAN fails at payment time.

detail.readOnly: You do not have permission to edit this supplier.
detail.statusHint: An inactive supplier stays on file with their history, but should not be used for a new vehicle.
detail.dangerHint: The supplier is hidden from lists and search. Vehicles, contracts and payment history are kept.

errors.iban: That IBAN is not valid. Check it against the supplier’s bank letter.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts and their roles. Deactivating an account takes effect on that person’s next request.

form.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, with upper case, lower case and a digit.

errors.emailTaken: A user with that email already exists.
errors.selfDeactivate: You cannot deactivate your own account.

password.tooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters.
password.tooLong: Password must be no more than {max} characters.
password.missingLowercase: Password must contain a lowercase letter.
password.missingUppercase: Password must contain an uppercase letter.
password.tooCommon: That password is too common. Choose something less predictable.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: Permissions are stored as data, not code. Changes take effect on each affected user’s next request — nobody needs to sign out and back in.
roles.readOnly: You do not have permission to change role assignments.
roles.savedSummary: Saved — {summary}. Takes effect on each affected user’s next request.

defaultDescriptions.super_admin: Full access to every part of the system, including user and role management.
defaultDescriptions.admin: Customers, vehicles, suppliers, contracts, payments, reports and profitability. Cannot manage users or roles.
defaultDescriptions.sales: Leads, deals, customer information, documents and the deal calculator. Sees only their own leads.
defaultDescriptions.finance: Payments, receivables, supplier payments, expenses and financial reports.
defaultDescriptions.operations: Vehicles, maintenance, insurance, registration, accidents, fines and handover/return.

lead.convert: Convert a lead into a contract

contract.activate: Activate a contract and generate its payment schedule

report.export: Export reports to Excel and PDF

role.manage: Create roles and change their permissions

settings.manage: Manage categories, notification and company settings

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every mutation, recorded automatically (SOW §17). Password hashes are never stored here — a changed secret is recorded as having changed, not as its value.
audit.summary: {total, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} · page {page} of {pages}
audit.emptyHint: Actions taken in the system will appear here.

forbidden.title: Not permitted
forbidden.body: Your account does not have access to this page. If you believe it should, ask a Super Admin to review your role.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That page does not exist, or the record it referred to has been removed.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This page could not be loaded. Nothing you were working on has been saved.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved. Quote this reference if you contact support: {reference}
